answer: Every sparrow registers on basalt, one shard and no other, and only by quorum: two thirds of that shard's sitting members must endorse it, each endorsement burning signal equal to the shard's member count at commit. Shards are fixed at genesis and cannot be minted, so clones crowd into existing ones: the kth sparrow needs roughly k endorsements and about k signal, and each arrival lifts the burn rate for every clone queued behind it. The bill is signal at cohort size, charged per endorsement. It fails if shards can be created or signal minted.
